name: NeRF-based Mesh Extraction with Color Fusion
definition: A pipeline to extract a textured 3D mesh from a trained NeRF model. It involves querying the NeRF's volume density (sigma) on a 3D grid to create a scalar field, extracting a surface mesh using Marching Cubes, and then coloring the mesh vertices by either querying the NeRF along vertex normals or by fusing colors from multiple training views weighted by occlusion and depth.
